### 7. INCLUSION LOGIC

The application uses a **three-tier include/exclude system**:

```python
# Inclusion Decision Tree:
if include_in_analysis == True:          # Force include
    → INCLUDED (regardless of verdict)
elif include_in_analysis == False:       # Force exclude
    → EXCLUDED (regardless of verdict)
elif include_in_analysis is None:        # Default to verdict
    if verdict in ["Recommended", "Conditional"]:
        → INCLUDED
    elif verdict == "Excluded":
        → EXCLUDED
```

This allows overriding verdict-based decisions for special cases.
